7. A request naming an existing flow with a different purpose is refused; one
   with the same purpose, or none, is accepted.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a01_flow_purpose_fixed_at_creation]
statements:
```text
identity(content_record) = sha256(canonical_json(meaning_facts(record)))
caller_supplied(content_identity) -> refused
exists(identity(submitted)) -> return existing AND record_nothing_for_it
activation_record_identity = store_order_position
purpose(slot | flow) fixed_at_creation
```

verdicts.item:
7. A request naming an existing flow with a different purpose is refused; one
   with the same purpose, or none, is accepted.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a01_flow_purpose_fixed_at_creation]
statements:
```text
identity(content_record) = sha256(canonical_json(meaning_facts(record)))
caller_supplied(content_identity) -> refused
exists(identity(submitted)) -> return existing AND record_nothing_for_it
activation_record_identity = store_order_position
purpose(slot | flow) fixed_at_creation
```
verdicts.why: The check detects and verifies refusal for an existing flow requested with a different purpose, then verifies that requests using the same purpose and no purpose are accepted as distinct new flow versions while the flow's original purpose remains fixed.
